national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Eight Railway Multitracking Projects Worth Over Rs 20,800 Crore
bullets: The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved eight railway multitracking projects worth over Rs 20,800 crore across nine states.
The projects will cover 1,196 km across 31 districts, improving connectivity to about 2,100 villages with a combined population of 52 lakh, and are targeted for completion by 2029-30.
The Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train project's initial 100 km section from Surat to Vapi in Gujarat is scheduled to commence next year.

national_news.title: India and Sri Lanka Sign MoUs on L70 Guns Upgradation and Defence Cooperation
bullets: India and Sri Lanka exchanged MoUs on the upgradation of L70 air defence guns for the Sri Lankan Air Force and cooperation between National Cadet Corps and National Defence Colleges.
Defence Minister Rajnath Singh visited Sri Lanka and met President Anura Kumara Dissanayake and Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya in Colombo.
Both leaders virtually inaugurated three Bailey Bridges constructed by the Indian Defence Forces, reaffirming mutual commitment to regional security.

national_news.title: India Wins Two Gold and Four Bronze at World Archery Para Series Stage III in Ahmedabad
bullets: India concluded its World Archery Para Series Stage III campaign in Ahmedabad with two gold and four bronze medals.
Sheetal Devi won the para compound women's individual gold medal through a dramatic shoot-off against Kazakhstan’s Aizada Seidan.
Paralympics champion Harvinder Singh and Bhawna secured the gold medal in the para recurve mixed team event by defeating China.

national_news.title: India Endorses Call to Action for 6G Leadership and Security at G20 Innovation Ministerial
bullets: India endorsed the Call to Action for 6G Leadership and Security, joining like-minded governments to shape 6G wireless communication standards.
Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia announced the endorsement on the sidelines of the G20 Innovation Ministerial held in North Carolina, USA.
The initiative aims to secure 10 percent of global 6G standards and coordinate national strategies ahead of expected rollout in the 2030s.

national_news.title: National Consumer Helpline Facilitates Rs 105 Crore Refunds at Pre-Litigation Stage
bullets: The National Consumer Helpline (NCH) facilitated refunds exceeding 105 crore rupees across 35 sectors over a 15-month period from 25th April 2025 to 31st July 2026.
The initiative falls under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, providing timely relief at the pre-litigation stage without approaching Consumer Commissions.
The e-commerce sector recorded the highest grievances and refunds (over Rs 74 crore), followed by Travel and Tourism (exceeding Rs 10 crore).
NCH operates via a convergence-based mechanism, offering grievance redressal in 17 languages across pan-India channels.

national_news.title: India to Work with BRICS Partners to Expand Opportunities for Women-Led Enterprises in Global Trade
bullets: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal addressed the BRICS WBA Women-Led Development Conference in New Delhi.
Goyal emphasized easing three key borders for women entrepreneurs: access to credit, access to buyers/markets, and predictable rules for free trade.
Highlighted India's financial inclusion metrics, including around 300 million bank accounts opened for women and collateral-free loans.
Noted the progress of 'Lakhpati Didis' where over 30 million rural women earn more than Rs 1 lakh in personal income through nearly 9 million self-help groups.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Visits Sri Lanka
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is on a three-day official visit to Sri Lanka, interacting with the Indian diaspora and senior leadership.
Noted that India's economy grew at 7.8% in the first quarter of 2026-27 and highlighted trade deals concluded over the last 12 years.
Emphasized shared cultural, historical, and civilisational ties between India and Sri Lanka.

national_news.title: Grand Send-off for Indian Contingent for Asian Games 2026
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya gave a grand send-off to the 503-member Indian contingent for the Asian Games 2026 in New Delhi.
The Asian Games 2026 are scheduled to be held in Japan.
India aims to host the Olympic Games by 2036 with a ten-year sports infrastructure plan allocated over 36,000 crore rupees.

national_news.title: 9th National Nutrition Month Inaugurated in Varanasi
bullets: The 9th National Nutrition Month was inaugurated at the International Rudraksh Convention Center in Varanasi by Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath and Union Minister for Women and Child Development Annapurna Devi.
The campaign emphasizes pure and balanced nutrition linked to the health of mothers, children, and families under the vision prioritized since 2014.

Anganwadi centres in Uttar Pradesh are being transformed into holistic hubs for children's health, early development, and nutrition distribution under the 'Our Anganwadi, Our Responsibility' public participation campaign.

national_news.title: Mizoram’s Saitual Becomes First District to Achieve ‘Surakshit’ HIV Status
bullets: Saitual district in Mizoram became the first in the state to attain 'Surakshit' status under the National AIDS Control Organisation's (NACO) Mobilisation AIDS Suraksha (MAS) campaign.
The district achieved all three UNAIDS-linked 95-95-95 HIV treatment and prevention targets regarding diagnosis, antiretroviral therapy (ART), and viral load suppression.
Under the MAS campaign, districts are categorized into Sangharshee, Saksham, Surakshit, and Surakshit+ based on their performance metrics.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog National Workshop on Strengthening Ayush Ecosystem
bullets: Union Minister of State for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav urged States and UTs to enhance Ayush services nationwide at a workshop in Hyderabad.
The national workshop on 'Strengthening the Ayush Ecosystem' was organized by NITI Aayog at Kanha Shanti Vanam, Hyderabad.
Discussions focused on integrating Ayush with mainstream healthcare, quality improvement, accessibility, and technology-integrated evidence-based approaches.

national_news.title: DRI Conducts Pan-India Crackdown Seizing 740 kg of Cannabis and Charas
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized approximately 740 kg of cannabis and charas in a nationwide crackdown over a fortnight.
A total of 13 individuals were arrested under the provisions of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.
Operations spanned road, rail, and air corridors, including major interceptions in Raipur, along the Aurangabad-Patna highway, Ludhiana, Gorakhpur, and international airports.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Inaugurates Global Fintech Fest 2026 in Mumbai
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 'Global Fintech Fest 2026' in Mumbai, hailing Unified Payments Interface (UPI) as the foundation of India's fintech transformation.

The flagship digital payment system is currently live in 11 countries, with ongoing efforts to integrate UPI directly with domestic payment networks of partner nations similar to the Singapore cross-border model.
The global expansion aims to significantly reduce remittance costs for the diaspora and accelerate international fund transfers.

national_news.title: Nagaland Observes 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah 2026 with Focus on Anganwadi Services
bullets: Nagaland is observing the month-long 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah across the state under the theme 'Hamari Anganwadi, Hamari Jimmedari' (Our Anganwadi, Our Responsibility).

The campaign highlights five key priorities, including protein-rich dietary diversity, fresh meals at Anganwadi centres, early childhood stimulation, and marking the 10-year milestone of Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY).
It emphasizes the first 1,000 days of a child's life using learning tools like Navchetna and Aadharshila, alongside enrollment drives for Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT).

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Develop Bodh Gaya as Major Eco-Tourism Hub
bullets: The Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department of Bihar is developing Bodh Gaya into an eco-tourism hub.
Key sites targeted for nature-based tourism include Maya Sarovar, Muchalinda Sarovar, Dungeshwari area, and surrounding hills.
Planned activities feature nature walks, trekking, bird-watching, nature camps, and eco-friendly accommodations to boost tourism and local handicrafts.

bihar_news.title: Severe Floods Impact Over 40 Lakh People Across 14 Districts in Bihar
bullets: Floods affected over 40.21 lakh people across 514 gram panchayats in 14 districts of Bihar due to incessant rain and heavy rainfall in catchment areas of Nepal.
According to the Disaster Management Department (DMD), September rainfall recorded 79.6 mm, which is 31 percent above normal.
The Ganga river at Sultanganj in Bhagalpur crossed its previous Highest Flood Level (HFL) of 36.75 metres (recorded in 2021) to reach 36.78 metres.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Industries Department Signs MoU with AIM Global Foundation for Food Processing Park
bullets: The Industries Department of Bihar signed an MoU with AIM Global Foundation at the AIM Congress 2026 in Dubai.
The partnership aims to establish an integrated agri-food and food processing cluster backed by investments from the UAE and Gulf region.
The initiative seeks to connect Bihar's farmers and industries with global supply chains ahead of the Rising Bihar 2026 summit.

bihar_news.title: Indian States Pitch for Gulf Investments in UAE
bullets: Indian states including Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, and Punjab are actively engaging with Gulf investors, sovereign wealth funds, and family offices in the UAE.
The outreach focuses on pitching manufacturing, agriculture, mining, logistics, and technology capabilities, utilizing the UAE as a gateway to global markets.
States are offering customized incentives, industrial land, and sector-specific opportunities to attract big-ticket foreign investments.
